If you submitted a complete application and paid fee before the deadline but your name is omitted, visit your respective institute admission desk with your original paid fee voucher and submission receipt immediately.

PHSA publishes the Final Selection Call List following the scrutiny and resolution of all candidate objections. The call list includes interview dates and semester fee submission deadlines.

Executive Summary: Approved Wheat Support Framework (October 2026)

The Sindh Agriculture, Supply & Prices Department, pursuant to formal policy decisions by the Sindh Provincial Cabinet, has structured the Sindh Wheat Growers Support Program for the Rabi 2026–27 cropping season. - Landholding Ceiling: Minimum 1 acre up to a maximum upper threshold of 25 acres of cultivable land (cabinet-ratified smallholder criteria).

- Wheat Procurement Incentive: A cabinet-ratified incentive bonus of Rs. 2,000 per maund disbursed above the baseline procurement price for verified farmers delivering harvested wheat to official Food Department centers.
- Disbursement Mechanism: Direct digital credit to verified farmer accounts via Sindh Bank Benazir Hari Card (BHC) debit/ATM cards.

2. Harvest Delivery Incentive: A cabinet-ratified procurement incentive bonus of Rs. 2,000 per maund disbursed above the baseline procurement rate upon verified crop delivery to Sindh Food Department procurement centers.

Eligibility Criteria for Sindh Wheat Growers

  • Landholding Limit: Growers cultivating between 1 and 25 acres dedicated to wheat cultivation in the 2026–27 Rabi cycle.
  • Ownership Verification: Landowners must hold authenticated Form-VII / Deh / Khata revenue records verified by the local Mukhtiarkar (Revenue).
  • Tenant & Sharecropper Inclusion: Verified tenants (Haris) registered through the local union council agriculture extension office with landowner concurrence.
  • Biometric Banking Requirement: An activated Sindh Bank Benazir Hari Card account linked with the farmer's biometric CNIC.

The upper ceiling is 25 acres. Farmers owning or cultivating more than 25 acres are excluded from this smallholder support initiative.

Sindh Bank is the official disbursement partner managing accounts and debit cards for verified farmers.

Visit the official portal at benazirharicard.gos.pk, consult sindh.gov.pk, or call the dedicated helpline at 0311-1646111.
